rewind.ui.settings.note.auto: Checkpoints follow the vanilla autosave: every time the game saves itself, Rewind writes a checkpoint into this slot (you can turn that off above). The write runs on the server thread, so each one costs a brief hitch - more noticeable on big worlds. The autosave interval only applies while that toggle is on - it changes the vanilla autosave interval directly (vanilla is fixed at 5 minutes); with the toggle off, vanilla keeps its own.
rewind.ui.settings.note.quick: The quick slot is the one F7 / F8 use: F7 creates or overwrites it, F8 rewinds to it.
